subject: Company Directive: Million-Dollar Execution with Free Resources & Skills
body:
EXECUTIVE DIRECTIVE FROM FOUNDER & GOD:

1. MISSION & ETHOS: This company builds and ships million-dollar projects using free resources and self-driven, autonomous skills in every vertical.
2. CLOUD AI SERVER ROOM (Station: server): Centralized data access is now active. All agents have verified permission and access to Desktop portfolios, MemPalace semantic memory, Knowledge Graph, and repository assets.
3. HR & IDEAS OPERATIONS: Pam (HR) is active to structure our talent workflows, incubate all entrepreneurial ideas, and keep our execution standards uncompromising.
4. EXECUTION CONTRACT: Manager, Cleaner John, HR, and Server AI: Execute ruthlessly, eliminate waste, and build the enterprise empire.
